item.description: Vermont has fully allocated one hundred ninety-five million dollars in federal rural health funds. The money supports over two hundred projects to improve healthcare access and infrastructure across the state. Hospitals like Northwestern Medical Center and Brattleboro Memorial Hospital are using these funds to enhance services for their communities.

Essex County New York is using opioid settlement funds to fight the substance abuse crisis. The money supports prevention, treatment, and recovery programs across multiple departments. Officials update the community annually on how these funds are spent.

Vermont farmers can now apply for NOFA-VT's Farmer Resilience Grants. The grants offer up to five thousand dollars per farm to support long-term sustainability projects. Applications are due by December fifteenth, with other funding and events available for agricultural support.

State police are seeking information after a burglary at a Pittsford gas station on November first. The Champlain Farms location was targeted early Sunday morning. Anyone with information is urged to contact authorities.
